result.summary:
CODE-DESIGNER, WF-03 step 2 round 2 for ISS-0002. Design only: the one project file changed is docs/design/REQ-002-idea-verdict.md (version 4, round 2). docs/requirements.yaml, tools/ and every other file are untouched. Next: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR.

WHAT CHANGED
- W51: RF, apply-report.json is a fifo -> 'E_WRITE <R>/apply-report.json: is not a regular file (EINVAL); nothing was changed'. Every CLI spawn now has a 10 s timeout, so the pre-fix run (which hangs reading the fifo) fails on A1 instead of hanging the suite.
- W52: RR, proposed-actions.json is a unix socket -> the same line for that target. The socket is made by a child node process started with cwd = the target folder, listening on the relative name and exiting at once. The socket file stays, and no chdir happens in the test process.
- P13: SIGKILL in the middle of writing run.json (partial-kill). K1 SIGKILL; K2 <R> absent; K3 the next prepare-run with the same args exits 1 with exactly the leftover line for runs/.WF06-20260925-01.sai-tmp; K4 delete it, then A6.
- P14: SIGKILL at the commit point (the rename of the temp folder; on the pre-fix code, the write of run.json). Same checks.
- L09: tree() lists a fifo and a socket as type 'o', never opens them, and finishes inside a timeout. Mutant M18 (read before the type check) must fail W51 and W52; M13 and M16 now also name P13 and L09.
- 9.1 got a table 'criterion 11, part by part -> tests'. I checked it against the live criterion 11 (REQ-002 block 39 lines, 99b10223...; file 4450091a...), the same text REQ-VALIDATOR r2 passed at 02:11Z. Every part maps to named rows: targets of both commands; each variant (apply-verdict target folder/link/not-regular W06-W12, W51, W52; path link W13; prepare-run path link P04 and file P03); read-only; leftovers; any OS error; both exceptions; SIGKILL for both commands (W47, W48, P13, P14); the P12 carve-out; convergence with the same args (A6 and K4).
- Fix A alignment: 4.1, 6 and 9 already said that any entry at the run-folder path is E_USAGE, exit 2 (P12). Wording now names any file type (fifo, socket) and states that 'not a regular file' is a rule for apply-verdict targets only (4.1 and the 6 E_WRITE row).
- Round-1 validator notes fixed: W46's A6 (the first re-run gives changed === 0); 5.2 item 3 states convergence in bytes with the same args, the same --created-at for prepare-run, output 'applied' or 'unchanged'; 7 lists --created-at; the criterion-3 row in 9 names prepare.write.test.js for prepare-run's E_WRITE.

EVIDENCE I PRODUCED (pre-fix copy, scratch .../scratchpad/cd-iss0002/probe-r2/, 2026-10-01)
- W51: status null, SIGTERM, ETIMEDOUT after 4008 ms with a 4 s timeout; STATE.md already changed, proposed-actions.json created.
- W52: exit 1, 'Unknown system error -102 ... open', 8 trace lines, STATE.md changed, apply-report.json untouched.
- P13: <R> left with all copies and run.json at 517 of 1035 bytes. P14: <R> left with copies and no run.json.
- The fixture target path is 108 bytes under this Mac's normal TMPDIR (getconf DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR is 49 bytes) and 187 bytes in an agent scratch TMPDIR. Both are over macOS's 104-byte socket limit, so the relative name is always needed.
- A socket created by a child process persists after the child exits, even at a 279-byte absolute path; reading it fails the same way as with a live server.
- server.close() after returning to the previous cwd did NOT remove the socket file. Node unlinks the relative name in the wrong folder, which could hit a same-named file in tools/. This is why the design uses a child process instead of chdir in the test process.

OPEN ITEMS FOR ORCH (unchanged from round 1 unless noted)
1. decisions/ entry for the write strategy (Q12): ORCH scheduled it after design validation, before implementation (REQ-VALIDATOR r2).
2. ISS-0003 text: its cases a and e are closed by this design (W19, P03).
3. WF-06 and verdict-executor.md do not say what to do on E_WRITE or leftovers; outside this run's write set.
4. validate reads through a symlinked run folder: register or accept (Q11).
5. TEST-DESIGNER and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR must be on the route (9.7). On the pre-fix copy, W51 runs to its 10 s timeout.

No agent events written (R2).
